name: yahoo_us_web_search
description: Search the Yahoo (US) web index. Returns title, real destination URL (Yahoo redirect links are unwrapped), snippet and source site. 7 results per page. Note: this is Yahoo US (search.yahoo.com), not Yahoo! JAPAN.

query.description: Search query for Yahoo (US). English works best; this is the US edition of Yahoo Search, separate from Yahoo! JAPAN.

name: yahoo_us_video_search
description: Search Yahoo (US) videos across YouTube and other hosts. Returns title, watch URL, duration, source site, description and thumbnail. 60 results per page.

query.description: Search query for Yahoo (US). English works best; this is the US edition of Yahoo Search, separate from Yahoo! JAPAN.

name: yahoo_us_image_search
description: Search Yahoo (US) images. Returns title, the page the image appears on, the original image URL, a thumbnail, dimensions and the source site. 60 results per page. Pages are fetched by the bundled helper process with a browser-grade client because Yahoo's image host refuses plain HTTP requests. The optional filters are the image SERP's own filter parameters; related queries found on the page are returned as related_queries.

query.description: Search query for Yahoo (US). English works best; this is the US edition of Yahoo Search, separate from Yahoo! JAPAN.

color.description: Dominant-colour filter (bw = black & white, color = full colour).

safesearch.description: SafeSearch setting (the vm parameter): "r" = on, "p" = off. Omitted leaves the server default in force.

name: yahoo_us_news_search
description: Search Yahoo (US) news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, relative publish time and a snippet. 10 results per page.

query.description: Search query for Yahoo (US). English works best; this is the US edition of Yahoo Search, separate from Yahoo! JAPAN.

name: yahoo_us_suggest
description: Get Yahoo (US) autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.

name: yahoo_us_build_search_url
description: Build the Yahoo (US) search URL for a query and vertical (web, image, video, news, suggest) without performing any search. Useful for handing a user a link to open themselves.

query.description: Search query for Yahoo (US). English works best; this is the US edition of Yahoo Search, separate from Yahoo! JAPAN.

vertical.description: Which search vertical the URL should open.

page.description: 1-based page number the URL should open.

name: yahoo_us_list_verticals
description: List the Yahoo (US) search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
